S01: Calaman, son of the king of France, dreamed of exploring the world.
S02: One day he finally resolved to leave home.
S03: He traveled long, through fields and forests of distant lands.
S04: At last he reached a dense, enchanted forest that swallowed the path.
S05: In the midst of the forest rose an enormous castle, darkened by secret magic.
S06: At the gate stood the guard with the long white beard.
S07: Calaman: "I would like to enter, with your permission."
S08: Guard: "This place belongs to the mighty wizard!"
S09: He had turned his relatives and subjects into the trees of the forest.
S10: Guard: "If you touch the splendors within, you too will become a tree!"
S11: But Calaman was brave and entered the castle.
S12: He touched neither the delicious food nor the gleaming gems and rubies.
S13: In a beautiful garden he found the princess, beautiful as the sun.
S14: Princess: "I have read the wizard's books — now I am more powerful than he. Together we shall break the spell!"
S15: In the evening, Marku Braz returned to the castle.
S16: He saw Calaman and his anger flared.
S17: With one sweep of magic, he captured him.
S18: Wizard: "Tomorrow you will face three challenges. If you fail them — your fate is dark!"
S19: At night, the princess secretly read the wizard's books.
S20: At dawn, the first challenge began.
S21: Out of the shadows came the first enemy, tall and armored.
S22: The princess whispered counsel to him and shielded him with magic.
S23: With her help, Calaman defeated the enemy.
S25: Out of the smoke appeared the monster with seven heads.
S26: Calaman stood firm before the dragon.
S27: First he cut off its tail.
S28: Then he struck off the head in the middle.
S29: So the remaining heads were easier to cut.
S30: At last the monster fell to the ground, overcome.
S31: Then the wizard himself attacked, with the enormous sword.
S32: Thanks to the princess's counsel and enchantments, he dodged the blade.
S34: And straight into the heart he thrust.
S35: The wizard vanished in a whirl.
S36: The castle fell silent, and the magic began to fade.
S38: And the castle windows lit for the first time in a long while.
S39: Little by little, the trees in the forest were transforming.
S40: They became again beautiful ladies and knights.
S41: The guard, now in splendid clothing, stepped forward.
S42: Guard: "I thank you with all my heart!"
S43: A great celebration began in the castle.
S44: Calaman and the princess were wed.
S46: The two walked through the garden, now all in bloom.
S47: The castle and the forest shone, freed from the spell.
